result:
I did not build this case. The OpenFlowsheet catalog has no unit that does what the case's `fs.heat_exchanger` does, and building a substitute is not allowed.

- **Required unit:** the case needs an IDAES `HeatExchangerLumpedCapacitance`. It is a crossflow exchanger with the LMTD temperature-difference callback and a steady-state energy balance. It is specified by area (65 m²), UA on each side (80 000 W/K) and a crossflow factor (0.75). The duty then follows from those values and the two feeds.
- **Closest available unit:** `syn001.heat_exchanger` has two hot and two cold material ports. Its only specification choices are hot outlet temperature, cold outlet temperature or duty. It has no area, UA or crossflow-factor parameters, and no lumped-capacitance or crossflow model. Using it would mean specifying a duty or outlet temperature that the case does not give, and the case's UA/area/crossflow calculation would be dropped.
- **Other units:** the rest of the catalog has no unit with area, UA or crossflow-factor parameters either.
- **Not checked:** I did not establish whether the IAPWS95 steam route (`fs.properties_shell`) or the benzene/toluene modular route (`fs.properties_tube`) is available. The catalog lists no property packages, and my one preview was rejected on missing schema fields before it said anything about components or property methods. I am therefore reporting only the unit as missing. The two feeds also use different property packages, which I could not confirm this version supports.

I committed no revision and submitted no job, so there is nothing to claim as converged or verified.
